import zipfile, os, subprocess, tempfile
z=zipfile.ZipFile('suite/fuzz/fuzz_disasmnext_seed_corpus.zip')
for n in z.namelist()[1:]:
    d=z.read(n)
    p='/tmp/inp'
    open(p,'wb').write(d)
    r=subprocess.run(['timeout','2','./build/fuzz_disasm',p],capture_output=True,text=True)
    if r.returncode not in (0,124):
        print('candidate',n,'rc',r.returncode)
        print(r.stdout[:200],r.stderr[:200])
        break
